title: C · 紧凑工作台
purpose: Layout selection preview; no product code changed
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Redesign the attached Chinese reaction-test web interface into a polished desktop layout concept. The attached screenshot is a visual reference for brand, warm white background, mint challenge color, thin borders, compact typography and SVG-like geometric icon language ONLY. Remove all browser tabs, address bar, bookmarks, browser frame and screenshot crop. Do not reproduce the incumbent main-column/right-sidebar composition. Render the actual application edge-to-edge on a wide 16:10 desktop canvas, approximately 1440x900, with crisp, legible simplified Chinese. Flat production web UI, not a poster, not a device mockup.
Preserve a very slim top header about 56px: small outlined rounded-square four-color ray mark with small “天赋测试” at left; “挑战大厅”, “排行榜”, “中文⌄” and small circular account avatar at right. Slim footer visible at the bottom: left “来一场小挑战，记录你的个人最佳。”, right “返回课程 ↗”. Header, content and footer all fit into one viewport. The brand is small, title modest, body text approximately 14–15px at this canvas size. No oversized hero heading. Warm off-white #fcfbf9, charcoal #202326, pastel mint #d9f5e1, calm muted ink, subtle green 1px outlines, restrained 8px corner radii, very slight short shadows, no gradients, no glass, no decorative illustrations, no fake scores, no AI badges. Use a simple green circle with 8 short ray marks as the reaction symbol.
Real product content: “返回大厅”, “反应力”, “反应测试”, “当背景变为绿色时，立即点击”, solid charcoal button “开始”. Supporting “玩法”: “随机等待 2–5 秒。变绿后点击，完成 5 个有效轮次，取平均耗时；抢点重试当前轮。” and “5 轮平均 · 越短越好”. Supporting “个人最佳”: an em dash instead of a made-up score, “完成一次挑战，留下你的第一份成绩。” and “查看排行榜 ↗”. Keep these functional contents with sensible hierarchy. This is the ready-to-start state; green-click mechanics are represented by the instruction, not by fabricated results. Do not include option names or A/B/C labels inside the app image.
COMPOSITION C — COMPACT UNIFIED GAME WORKBENCH WITH INTEGRATED STATUS.
Center a wide game workbench about 1040px wide, occupying about 530px of height, slightly above the viewport midpoint. This is structured as three attached horizontal bands in ONE thin-bordered 8px-radius frame. First band: 58px warm-white toolbar, small back link at far left, modest “反应力” title next to it, then at far right “个人最佳 —” and an underlined leaderboard link. Second band: dominant mint reaction stage about 340px high, centered reaction symbol about 56px, 24px “反应测试”, instruction and “开始” button, compact and focused. Third band: white compact 80px round-tracker strip: left label “5 轮平均 · 越短越好”, five orderly empty outlined round markers with “1” “2” “3” “4” “5” in the middle, right small “空格 / Enter”. Markers have no result values because the test has not started. Immediately below the unified frame, one narrow unboxed inline rules row with the full short rules, separated by natural spacing; second tiny line carries the true personal-best empty-state sentence. No side columns. No enormous empty space between the game and its support. Precise horizontal alignment, strong but restrained workbench hierarchy, all UI fits into one viewport with slim header/footer.
